gloss: sense of the season; seasonal feeling

definitions.gloss: sense of the season; seasonal feeling; awareness of the season
definitions.explanation: The feeling or awareness evoked by seasonal characteristics — sights, foods, weather, and customs that mark a particular time of year.

examples.japanese: {季節感|きせつかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To make food that reflects the season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{季節感|きせつかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じ→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧にくい。
examples.english: In the city, it's hard to feel a sense of the seasons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旬|しゅん}→旬：12716_shun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ことで、⟦{食卓|しょくたく}→食卓：03246_shokutaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{季節感|きせつかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{入|い}れている→取り入れる：04221_toriireru⟧。
examples.english: By using seasonal ingredients, I bring a sense of the season to the dinner table.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧ (season) + ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (sense/feeling). Reflects the deeply valued Japanese cultural concept of appreciating seasonal changes in food, clothing, decoration, and daily life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {季節感|きせつかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a seasonal feel
- {季節感|きせつかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel the season
- {季節感|きせつかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}にする→大切にする：26940_taisetsunisuru⟧: to value seasonality
- {季節感|きせつかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{入|い}れる→取り入れる：04221_toriireru⟧: to incorporate seasonal elements
- {季節感|きせつかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: lacking seasonal character

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese culture places great importance on seasonal awareness. This concept appears in cooking (⟦{旬|しゅん}→旬：12716_shun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧, seasonal ingredients), fashion (wearing appropriate colors and fabrics), interior decoration (⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧), greetings ({時候|じこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧), and traditional arts like haiku (⟦{季語|きご}→季語：09561_kigo⟧, seasonal words).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{風情|ふぜい}→風情：09057_fuzei⟧: elegance, atmosphere — broader aesthetic appreciation, not limited to seasons
- ⟦{情緒|じょうちょ}→情緒：09058_joucho⟧: sentiment, mood — emotional quality of an experience or place
